references.observed: The December 2025 viewpoint shows a continuous straight crest and the long pinkish beige Burla generating hall with a dark roof, its taller cream control block and the downstream retaining wall.
The downstream floodgate view shows recessed upper apertures, repeated sloping concrete faces, low outlet ports and the crest lamps. The temporary flood plume is excluded.
Gandhi Minar has a cream tapering cylindrical shaft, inset window slots and a dark teal observation cab with a broad cap.
The Burla hilltop view shows Nehru Minar beside the generating hall. The white shaft, broad deck and underside colonnade are distinct from Gandhi Minar.
